contract.title: Implement one-time bootstrap activation entry point
prohibited_actions: Execute any task other than INFRA-0012
Bypass authority or Product Owner controls
acceptance_criteria: Provide a dedicated one-time bootstrap_dispatch entry point bound only to INFRA-0012 and this authority chain
Validate parent waiting state HEAD repository identity and exact scope before durable claim
Persist immutable single-use claim and execution evidence before side effects
Reject replay expiry mismatch ambiguity and non-target tasks
Disable the entry point after terminal consumption and preserve ordinary dispatcher semantics
Add adversarial tests for all bindings and parent immutability
